name: @pipeworx/mcp-openweather

tools.name: current_weather
tools.description: Get the current weather for a city or coordinates: temperature, "feels like", conditions, humidity, wind speed, and cloud cover. Example: current_weather({ city: "London", units: "metric" })

city.description: City name, optionally with country code, e.g. "London" or "London,GB". Provide this OR lat/lon.

lat.description: Latitude. Use with lon instead of city.

lon.description: Longitude. Use with lat instead of city.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own OpenWeatherMap API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Get a multi-step weather forecast (3-hour intervals) for a city or coordinates: temperature, conditions, wind speed, and precipitation probability over time. Example: forecast({ city: "Tokyo", count: 8 })

city.description: City name, optionally with country code, e.g. "Tokyo" or "Tokyo,JP". Provide this OR lat/lon.

lat.description: Latitude. Use with lon instead of city.

lon.description: Longitude. Use with lat instead of city.

count.description: Number of 3-hour forecast steps to return (default 8 = next 24h, max 40 = 5 days).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own OpenWeatherMap API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: air_quality
tools.description: Get the current air quality for a set of coordinates: an air quality index (AQI, 1=Good to 5=Very Poor) plus pollutant component concentrations (CO, NO2, O3, PM2.5, PM10, etc.). Example: air_quality({ lat: 51.5, lon: -0.12 })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own OpenWeatherMap API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Resolve a place name (city, optionally with state/country) to geographic coordinates (latitude/longitude). Useful before calling air_quality, which needs lat/lon. Example: geocode({ query: "Paris", limit: 5 })

query.description: Place name to look up, e.g. "Paris", "Springfield,IL,US".

limit.description: Maximum number of matching locations to return (default 5).

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own OpenWeatherMap API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-openweather forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the openweather pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
